newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya Group raises stakes in units.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Group raises stakes in units.

text.p: Malaysia's Berjaya Group Bhd said on Friday it had raised its stakes in three subsidiaries for a total cost of 223.26 million ringgit.

The company said in a statement it had bought an additional 18.67 million shares in Berjaya Leisure Bhd for 65.53 million ringgit, taking its stake in Berjaya Leisure to 73.56 percent from 70.15 percent.

The group also said it had bought an additional 26.77 million shares, or a 9.58 percent interest, in Berjaya Singer Bhd for 90.89 million ringgit. This raised Berjaya Group's stake in Berjaya Singer to 66.0 percent.
Berjaya Group also acquired another 24.27 million shares in Berjaya Capital Bhd for 66.84 million ringgit, raising its stake in the unit to 60.84 percent from 56.53 percent.
Berjaya Group said the acquisitions were financed through internally generated funds and borrowings
The purchases were consistent with the group's policy of increasing its shareholdings in its subsidiaries when such shares were available at attractive prices, it said.

In a separate statement, Berjaya Leisure said it had raised its stake in gaming concern Berjaya Sports Toto Bhd to 60.95 percent through the purchase of 9.03 million shares, or a 1.59 percent interest, for 109.81 million ringgit. -- Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-230 8911)
